   [04DB6] 0xDBEC514779892A28: Let's first look at this vertical group of swatches, called the Pattern Skewer. This skewer contains the individual patterns for the object or clothing that you have selected. Some objects have more patterns than others, and patterns at the top of the skewer affect a larger area on the object, while patterns near the bottom affect a smaller area.
   [04DB7] 0xDBEC514779892A2B: Next, here's the Pattern Library. This area contains patterns split into categories, which can be selected from the drop down menu at the top. Clicking on a pattern will place that pattern in the currently selected slot in the Pattern Skewer.
   [04DB8] 0xDBEC514779892A2A: Each pattern has up to four colors, and each can be individually changed. The colors are ordered such that the ones on the left affect a larger area and the ones on the right affect a smaller area.    [04DB9] 0xDBEC514779892A2D: This panel in the upper-left corner of the screen allows you to manage preset styles. It will display any previously designed styles for the current object, with the * representing a style-in-progress. Custom styles will have a small icon in the corner of their thumbnails.
   [04DBA] 0xDBEC514779892A2C: Let’s look at the Pattern Skewer again. Notice the grip-dots at the top of the skewer. Clicking here will grab the skewer, allowing you to copy this entire style onto almost any other item by dragging it on to that object or piece of clothing.
   [04DBB] 0xDBEC514779892A2F: Individual patterns can be dragged similarly. Click and drag any pattern from the Pattern Skewer and it will attach to your cursor. You can now release the mouse button on another pattern in the skewer in order to overwrite it, click in between patterns on the skewer to re-order patterns, or click on another item to copy the pattern to that item.
   [04DBC] 0xDBEC514779892A2E: Individual colors, as well as the swatch representing combinations of colors, can be dragged in the same way. This is a great way to quickly get matching styles that use different patterns.
   [04DBD] 0xDBEC514779892A21: When you drag a pattern, individual color, or combination of colors from one object onto a different object, the Transfer Dialogue will appear. From here, you can choose which pattern on the new item to affect. Transferring a pattern will overwrite the old pattern, while colors will retain the pattern and only change its color information.

   [12692] 0x57595441F42F8E6C: PlantSims
   [12693] 0x9B84EB1633081B67: PlantSims are unique and have different needs than normal Sims. For instance, since they are more flora than fauna, they do not need to eat and will absorb nutrients from their surroundings. They also utilize fluids in a far more efficient manner than normal Sims and never need to empty their Bladder.
   [12694] 0x9B84EB1633081B64: In order to stay Hydrated and avoid getting Dried Out, PlantSims absorb Water by coming into contact with it. They can do this by bathing, swimming, or absorbing puddles. PlantSim babies and toddlers are naturally hydrated and don’t require Water.
   [12695] 0x9B84EB1633081B65: During the day, PlantSims have the ability to Photosynthesize which causes them to burrow under the ground and absorb Energy and Water. They also have the gift to Commune with Plants in order to help with their Social needs.
   [12696] 0x9B84EB1633081B62: PlantSims also have unique ways of expressing their fondness or dislike for Sims with kisses. Flower Kisses are a way to make a Sim obsess over your PlantSim while Poisonous Kisses will turn their stomachs. Other Sims can socialize with PlantSims to Ask for Herbs.
   [12697] 0x9B84EB1633081B63: PlantSims, being a product of nature and science, will learn the Gardening and Science Skills at an accelerated rate. That being said, PlantSims can also be cured with a visit to the Science Center or with a Bottle of Super Spice.
   [12698] 0x9B84EB1633081B60: If you wish to further your PlantSim family, you need only acquire a Forbidden Fruit and tend to it until it can be picked. Once it has reached this state, you have a chance to pull up your own little bundle of joy!

   [1269D] 0xA5AA58A7ED974A46: Roommates will generally start to arrive on your lot after 9:00 am the day after you advertisement goes out. Roommates will contribute rent to your household weekly based on the number of roommates you have and the value of your lot.

   [130A2] 0x0BCB3FEA447E0AB9: Resort Ownership and Management
   [130A3] 0x251434BEEFB1C98E: Earn some money on the side or choose to run your own high powered mega-resort. Resorts allow your Sims to have the opportunity to run their own business. There are different ways to obtain a resort. Select "Become a Resort Owner" from your phone and choose a lot that you want to build a resort on. If you already own a private residential lot or island, click on the map tag and choose "Convert to Resort".
   [130A4] 0xB31F2E714B197C7A: Keep tabs on your resort operations by viewing the Finances menu. This can be found on the front desk or on any wall or roof on your resort. Here you can view key statistics such as occupancy, revenue, and expenses. Choose to update amenity business decisions or hire new employees directly from this panel. Keep your finances balanced to prevent your resort from being closed down.
   [130A5] 0xB31F2E714B197C7B: Get feedback about how your resort is performing by checking out the Resort Reviews panel. This selection can be found on the front desk or on any wall or roof on your resort. Here you can view your current star rating and read comments from your guests about their recent stay. Improve your resort based on reviewers' feedback or keep things just the way they are. It's really up to you. Hey, if you're making money, why change anything?
   [130A6] 0x251434BEEFB1C98D: Now that you own a resort, it is time to build it out and customize it. Use Build and Buy Modes to build structures and place down key resort amenity objects. Resort specific catalog sorts allow you to easily find objects that allow business operation options. Decorations also contribute to your resort rating. If you're looking for a quick way to build your resort, you can try using Blueprint Mode. There are new resort-specific blueprints to choose from.
   [130A7] 0x251434BEEFB1C98C: When using blueprints to build out your resort be sure to read the special instructions or hints for each type. Some blueprints will require you to set additional settings in Live Mode in order for them to work properly.
   [130A8] 0x251434BEEFB1C98B: VIP door locks are specific to resorts and will need to be set for each guest room whether built through a blueprint or build/buy. In Live Mode click on a door to add a new or existing VIP door lock. You will want to assign a unique VIP door lock key to all doors that lead to a guest room. Note that resort towers don't need door locks as they're automatically managed by the resort.
   [130A9] 0x251434BEEFB1C98A: Customize employee uniforms to fit the theme of your resort. Choose a preset theme for all resort employees from the front desk or change it for each worker by selecting the option directly from the amenity object. A higher level of customization is available by clicking on a worker and choosing to create a customized uniform. Custom uniforms are assigned per Sim so hiring a new employee will force the default outfit.
   [130AA] 0x251434BEEFB1C989: Before you open your resort to the public, here are a few tips on how to keep your new business profitable. One of the main goals for managing resorts is to maintain a healthy occupancy level. The happiness of your resort guests are a big part of what makes sure that they keep coming back for more. Provide a good amount of amenities for your guests to enjoy and make sure your pricing is appropriate to your current star rating. Finding this balance is key to a profitable resort!
   [130AB] 0x251434BEEFB1C988: Open your resort from the front desk and guests should immediately start filing in. Some resort amenities will allow you to make business decisions. Choose wisely as there are benefits and drawbacks to every decision. Employees will automatically be hired for your front desk, bar, and food stand but you always have the power to replace them.
   [130AC] 0x251434BEEFB1C987: Busy resorts will require maintenance. Hire maintenance workers from the front desk or save some money and do all of the cleaning and fixing yourself. Higher level workers are more efficient in doing their job. Keep your resort clean. Nobody likes a dirty resort.
   [130AD] 0x251434BEEFB1C986: Amenity workers such as ones you hire to operate the front desk, food stand, and bars are permanent employees. Thus they are listed individually in your finance panel. However, maintenance workers are temporary and can be swapped out with another NPC without you even knowing about it so don't be surprised if you see a new worker cleaning up your resort. This is why they are all lumped in as a single category called "Maintenance Workers" in your finance panel.
